notes.title: Update 1.05
notes.notes: [h1]Change log 1.05[/h1][p]- [b]\[Experimental][/b] You can now hit X to fast forward to the end of a line of dialogue.[/p][p]- Rescaled maps and enemies to make hacking easier.[/p][p]- Fixed bug where 4 missiles in a square would brick the game.[/p][p]- Lowered the unlock price of the missile and splitter (so hard players can try them out).[/p][p]- Fixed bug with exiting and starting a new save, resulting in some events not playing.[/p][p]- Now asks you to confirm before overwriting your save.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: METTA://Profile_ISSEI-ITO
notes.notes:
Employee name: Issei Ito
Age: 32 years old
Height: 5’7’’
Position: Security Specialist
Fun Fact: Has only one suit to wear to work

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45103040/7994be2cada8c4cc985c3c47c34e0a97f7da7af5.png[/img]

	Issei works admirably enough as a security specialist, ensuring that our hardware and software are as impenetrable as advertised. His work ethic has caught the eye of his Supervisor, Ota, lining him up as a likely candidate for a promotion that comes with a hefty raise, which he could use because he’s bad with money (allegedly). 

Just kidding, he’s in huge debt and would do anything to get out of it, a useful trait in an employee. But really, someone should get this guy away from the poker tables and into a statistics class or something. In all seriousness, he’s a good employee who has potential, he just doesn’t seem to be living up to it. That’s just what office work does to people… at least his debt encourages him to work harder, which is all we care about. 

He’s relatively well-liked by those he works with, especially Ota and Mae Azumi. Nagano Kenta, however, is not one of those people.
